description: This Java class defines a custom exception used within the Fineract project to handle cases where a loan application cannot be modified due to its current state. Specifically, it signals that a loan application is neither in submitted nor pending approval status and thus cannot be changed.

classes.name: LoanApplicationNotInSubmittedAndPendingApprovalStateCannotBeModified
classes.description: A specialized exception class extending AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException, used to indicate invalid modification attempts on loan applications outside the allowed states.

methods.name: LoanApplicationNotInSubmittedAndPendingApprovalStateCannotBeModified
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a specific message, including the loan application identifier.

calls: super(String code, String defaultMessage, Long id)
